_comment: THE TURN HOOK (18 Aug 2026, OVERHAUL Block 1 · §7.4/§14.8): UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart each ran FIVE node processes per event; measured that day, ~80% of every hook's cost was node booting (bare node = 172 ms cold, each callee 217-267 ms). All three anchors now run ONE dispatcher (Stop joined 18 Aug 2026 evening, Block 2: `stop` runs teaching_audit hook · intent stop — the session-intent row, §7.2), scripts/turn_hook.mjs — `prompt` runs forge_session contract · teaching_contract print · teaching_audit hook · hippocampus recall-hint, and `start` runs teaching_contract reset-turns · learnstate brief · forge_session boot · watchman brief · captains_call deal — IN-PROCESS, in this exact order, each callee's OWN dispatch printing its OWN stdout (proven byte-identical against the five separate commands before this file was switched: prompt 996 B = 996 B, start 11,804 B = 11,804 B; in-process cost prompt 89 ms, start 425 ms of which learnstate brief is most). afferent-post.mjs stays its own process on purpose: it is the capture nerve (stdout-free, POSTs to the thalamus) and must never share a fate with the pacer. Every callee keeps its own selftest and its own ARSENAL_ORGAN guard; turn_hook writes nothing. The five-command history below is kept verbatim as the record of WHY each callee exists. ——— ORIGINAL RECORD: THE CLAUDE CODE CAPTURE NERVE. UserPromptSubmit + Stop both fire hooks/afferent-post.mjs — a fail-silent (~250ms), stdout-free, secret-scrubbing bridge that POSTs to the thalamus (:4113) as a 'code' afferent. UserPromptSubmit captures HIS words (source 'claude-code'); Stop captures WHAT HE WAS TAUGHT (last_assistant_message, source 'claude-code-teaching') — so the WHOLE learning turn (question + answer) flows into the ONE working memory with zero capture tax. Relative command (CWD = project root); never blocks the session; thalamus down = silent no-op. THE FORGE PACER (30 Jul 2026): UserPromptSubmit ALSO fires `forge_session.mjs contract`, whose stdout IS injected by design — THE METHOD's 12-step order + the two anti-quiz-dump laws, re-read EVERY turn instead of once at skill-load (prose read once drowns after 40 turns; that is exactly how 8 of 12 steps went missing on the first live session). Silent unless a fresh, unclosed forge session exists; silent for headless organs (ARSENAL_ORGAN=1). THE BOOT LINE (31 Jul 2026): SessionStart ALSO fires `forge_session.mjs boot` — read-only, never writes, at most two lines, silent for headless organs (ARSENAL_ORGAN=1) and silent when there is no session and no history. It deliberately speaks on a STALE session: staleness silences the PACER, never the MEMORY. Companion: learnstate.mjs brief now splices the hippocampus rehydrate cartridge, so a fresh session arrives holding his durable memory instead of making him re-explain himself. THE TEACHING CONTRACT (31 Jul 2026): UserPromptSubmit ALSO fires `teaching_contract.mjs print`. The pacer re-injected the METHOD every turn but the HOW-TO-TEACH rules arrived only once, at SessionStart — and the measured result over a 5-hour session was zero method-drifts and four teaching-drifts (scope, role, language, terminology). This organ closes that asymmetry: <=5 lines, drift-RANKED (the rule he has been failed on most is injected first), rotating (every other rule still resurfaces), with the already-closed-concepts line DERIVED live from sprint.json so it needs no maintenance. It also carries the turn clock that raises his explicitly-requested CONTEXT WARNING before compaction, instead of relying on the model to remember to warn him. AUDIT #107 (5 Aug 2026): three fixes land here. (1) SessionStart now runs `teaching_contract.mjs reset-turns` FIRST — the organ's own header has named this the sanctioned session boundary since 2 Aug and it was never wired, so the clock had no reset path. (2) The CONTEXT WARNING no longer rides the turn counter; it rides the TRANSCRIPT'S SIZE, because a measured fork mid-conversation (session id bd2d46c2 -> fa94c375) zeroed the counter at exactly the moment the context was largest — #38's failure mode inverted from 'always fires' into the worse, silent 'never fires'. The new transcript file inherited the history (710,280 -> 958,257 bytes), so size carries across a fork where identity does not. (3) PreCompact now prints the kickoff brief, so orientation survives into the compacted context instead of depending on SessionStart's compact-source firing. THE CONTEXT MANIFEST (5 Aug 2026): `learnstate.mjs brief` now renders through scripts/context_manifest.mjs — an explicit 12,000-char budget spent worst-priority-first, with a footer naming every part's byte count and anything missing or trimmed. It exists because the brief silently dropped 1,957 of the hippocampus cartridge's 4,157 characters at EVERY SessionStart, and because the PENDING IDENTITY FACTS queue had no path into the brief at all. Size was never the problem; silent loss was. THE COMPLIANCE AUDIT'S SECOND HOOK (7 Aug 2026, self-sustaining repair): teaching_audit.mjs now ALSO fires on UserPromptSubmit — the Stop payload carries NO user text (afferent-post.mjs:59-62 is the field map), so the confusion-is-literal check could never see his words until the prompt was recorded at prompt time and consumed at Stop. Stop-side it audits the turn against the live forge session (the reader that expected a `.session` wrapper never audited a single turn — BRIEF__self_sustaining_organism.md §5.1), auto-counts measured drifts per his 6 Aug two-lane ruling, and stamps the checked_at heartbeat the close report has read since audit #40. THE WATCHMAN (7 Aug 2026): SessionStart also fires `watchman.mjs brief` — ONE line, only when last night's Tier-1 sweep found something or the watchman itself has not run; silent on a clean, fresh night. The organ that finally asks 'did the organ that was supposed to produce output today produce any?' — the question §5.1 survived precisely because nobody asked it.

hooks._SessionEnd_comment: THE ARCHIVE'S TAIL (14 Aug 2026, ARCHIVE__DAY_ONE_SPEC.md §7.6). afferent.jsonl is a WRITE-AHEAD LOG and $ARSENAL_ARCHIVE is the durable store behind it, so the gap between 'he said it' and 'it is permanent' is the whole risk. The scheduled ArsenalFC-Archivist covers it every 15 minutes; this closes the last gap, archiving a session's tail the moment the session ends. SessionEnd AND NOT Stop, deliberately: an incremental run measures ~0.6s, which is nothing once at the end of a session and a real tax paid on EVERY turn of a study session. Layering, not replacing — if a session is killed and SessionEnd never fires, the 15-minute task still catches the tail; this only makes it prompt. The archivist is READ-ONLY on dressing-room/ and writes nothing this session can see, so it cannot bite the editor.
hooks._PreToolUse_comment: THE RAILS (AUDIT §10-C rung S1b, 20 Aug 2026). Root B of the audit: THE FACTORY IS LESS GUARDED THAN THE PRODUCT — both token disasters happened in SESSIONS, not in the organism (the 16-agent fleet; the 19-Aug reading session at 505.02 lakh weighted, ~2x the organism's whole week). The organism has a gate, a ledger, owners and a suite; the sessions that BUILD it had nothing. Prose in a work order cannot stop a session; a PreToolUse hook can, because it runs BEFORE the permission modes even under skip-permissions. THREE RAILS, each an accident that already happened: a fan-out with no ceiling in its prompt (Agent/Task/Workflow) . a session's EDITOR writing under dressing-room/state, or a shell redirecting into it (the owners-only law at session level) . `claude -p` from a session shell (the organism's own transport L6, outside the gate L5, in nobody's ledger, and the organism is switched off until S12). The matcher keeps the ~200ms node boot off every Read/Grep/Glob: only the tools a rail can actually refuse pay it. A deny costs nothing (the tool never runs) and every deny names the rail, the accident and the compliant form. OVERRIDE, per rung, declared IN THE CALL so it is visible in the transcript and expires with the call: ARSENAL_RAILS_OVERRIDE=<rung>:<rail>. FAIL-OPEN by design (the tripwire's precedent): if rails.mjs throws, the tool proceeds.
